statement: For every m=2^s with s at least 1, the genus-(m-1) curve v^2=w^(2m)-1 minus its four points at zero and infinity is a degree-2m geometric dihedral cover of U. Its Jacobian has potentially good reduction at 2 with special 2-rank zero and all cusp differences are killed by 4m. The full geometric pro-prime fixed subgroup is therefore selected cusp inertia for every prime, packet and indicated open derived subgroup.

answers: Part A Task 5: fixed groups of a second family of covers with unbounded genus m-1, m a power of two

notes: Full independent root proof/source audit PASS and exact code rerun PASS. The cusp-divisor integer combinations give a 2-primary annihilator, without claiming every cusp class has that exact order. The automorphism character algebra has dimension twice the genus and splits into cyclotomic CM fields. Each local field at 2 has degree twice its abelian factor dimension, so its action on the special etale 2-Tate module forces p-rank zero; no unverified Newton-polygon computation is used. Good Jacobian reduction gives compact type, and equal Abel specializations yield rational paths between all four cusps. Odd coefficients use A.41 and coefficient2 also follows independently from A.22. Exact code/a_two_power_dihedral.py/.json/.out executed PASS for m through64. No new higher-genus normalizer classification is asserted in this statement.
